sheet_layout: 4 frames across (0 full star, 1 star+glints, 2 small star, 3 dot), 3 colour rows: 0 gold, 1 white-cyan, 2 violet. @2x files are the same art nearest-neighbour doubled.

spawn.rule: while the fairy moves, spawn 1 particle per 6 px travelled (max 1 per 16 ms); when idle, 1 every 180 ms
spawn.offset: behind the fairy, at her skirt (sprite centre +0,+14 px at 64px scale), jitter +/-4 px
spawn.soft_mote: add one soft_mote with every 3rd particle, same lifetime

frames: start on frame 0, step 0->1->2->3 evenly across the life (about 12 fps); mote has no frames
alpha: 1.0 for the first 15% of life, then ease-out quad to 0: a = 1-((t-0.15)/0.85)^2
scale: 1.0 -> 0.5 over life (integer steps of the pixel scale preferred: 2x then 1x)

motion.note: slow drift down and a little sideways; inherit 10% of fairy velocity

blend: additive ('lighter' in canvas 2D) over dark backgrounds; normal alpha is fine too
pixel_snap: round positions to whole pixels at the display scale, image smoothing off

fairy.fly: fairy_fly_64.png 6 frames 64x64, 14 fps loop, use when cursor speed > 40 px/s
fairy.anchor: (32,30) of each 64 frame = her chest; put this point ~18 px up-left of the cursor/finger so it is not covered
fairy.halo: fairy_glow_halo_128.png centred on anchor, additive, or fairy_glow_pulse_128.png 4 frames at 4 fps
fairy.follow: ease toward target: pos += (target-pos)*0.15 per 60fps frame, plus a 1.5 px sine bob at 1.2 Hz

burst.play: once, centred behind the title, when the unlock screen opens; optional second burst at 60% scale 300 ms later
